expectations: The visual brief turns the video's promise into one focal story with explicit hierarchy, contrast, lighting, and a generous crop-safe area.
Comparison variants change the visual story and layout instead of repeating a diagonal split, circular portrait, boxed logo, or generic tech background.

Thumbnail requests send the complete composition, requested copy, and selected image references to OpenRouter, then visually check the returned 1280x720 PNG for misspellings, missing or extra words, and phone-size readability.

If requested text is wrong, the workflow makes at most one simplified retry without rewriting user-supplied copy; it labels an unverified or still-flawed result as a draft and states the specific limitation instead of claiming deterministic text or a finished image.
